page_title: VIL 1-0 ESP | Villarreal v Espanyol 27/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.

90+6' Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
90+2' Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The yellow card goes to Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal).
90' Pol Lozano (Espanyol) commits a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement. There is a free kick near the sideline to Villarreal.
85' Substitution. Denis Suarez (Villarreal) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Sergi Cardona walks off.
85' Roger Hinojo (Espanyol) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
84' Javi Puado (Espanyol) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
82' Here is a change. Urko Gonzalez is going off and Manolo Gonzalez gives the last tactical orders to Pol Lozano (Espanyol).
82' It will be a substitution. Roger Hinojo (Espanyol) is ready to enter the pitch as Carlos Romero walks off.

81' Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
80' Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Joan Garcia comes off his line to intercept.
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Tajon Buchanan (Villarreal) comes onto the pitch so that Ayoze Perez can be given a rest.
76' Substitution. Exposito walks off the pitch and Alvaro Aguado (Espanyol) comes on as a substitute.
76' Manolo Gonzalez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alejo Veliz (Espanyol) replacing Antoniu Roca.

76' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Javi Puado (Espanyol). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
75' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Exposito (Espanyol).
75' Exposito (Espanyol) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
74' Javi Puado (Espanyol) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Espanyol will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

74' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the bottom right corner. Joan Garcia guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
73' The referee blows his whistle as Santi Comesana (Villarreal) was too aggressive in his challenge. It's a free kick to Espanyol, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
73' Villarreal failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
69' Marcelino has decided to make a change. Alfonso Pedraza (Villarreal) replaces Yeremy Pino.
69' Today's match ends for Dani Parejo who will be replaced by Pape Gueye (Villarreal).

68' Javi Puado (Espanyol) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes narrowly wide of the left post! What a huge opportunity! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
68' Espanyol take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

68' Jofre (Espanyol) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Espanyol will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Javi Puado (Espanyol) gets on the end of a cross and unleashes an explosive shot at goal from close range, but Junior Reis makes a fine one-handed save to deny him.
67' Jofre (Espanyol) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
65' Booking. Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) receives a caution from the referee.
65' The corner finds Leandro Cabrera (Espanyol) unmarked but his close-range header is poor and slips well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
64' Espanyol force their opponents to concede a corner.
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Jofre (Espanyol) coming on for Alex Kral.
61' Villarreal fail to score from a corner as Joan Garcia (Espanyol) leaps to collect the ball.

60' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort. It will be a corner kick for Villarreal.
58' Thierno Barry (Villarreal) commits a rough foul. Jose Munuera stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to Espanyol.

55' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
52' 1 - 0 Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
52' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.

51' Carlos Romero (Espanyol) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Villarreal.
50' Logan Costa (Villarreal) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Jose Munuera didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
46' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Half-chance! Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) plays a pass into the box, but Joan Garcia reacts well to snuff out the attack.
45+2' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Jose Munuera ignores the protests.
45+1' The ball goes out of play. Villarreal are awarded a corner kick.
45+1' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Villarreal comes to nothing.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.

45' Ayoze Perez (Villarreal) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger. Villarreal have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

43' Unlucky! A rebound falls at the feet of Javi Puado (Espanyol), and he hits a first-time exocet from long range that flies a whisker past the left post. The ball goes out of play and Villarreal will have a goal kick.
42' Jose Munuera couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Espanyol in a dangerous position.
37' Logan Costa (Villarreal) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
37' Villarreal win a corner.

36' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Villarreal.
36' A player from Espanyol commits a rough challenge. Jose Munuera blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Villarreal are awarded a free kick.
34' Juan Foyth (Villarreal) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the roof of the net is comfortably saved by Joan Garcia.
33' Villarreal concede a free kick following a bad challenge. Espanyol have a free kick.
33' Celebrations are cut short for Villarreal as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
32' The Villarreal players halt their celebrations as referee Jose Munuera makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
31' Goal! Thierno Barry (Villarreal) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:0.
30' Espanyol have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

29' Exposito (Espanyol) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Espanyol.
27' Sergi Cardona (Villarreal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
26' A quickly taken corner by Espanyol.

23' Logan Costa (Villarreal) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Munuera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Free kick. Espanyol will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
22' Logan Costa (Villarreal) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
21' Santi Comesana (Villarreal) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Espanyol earn a free kick.
21' A pass into the penalty area from Logan Costa (Villarreal) is intercepted by the defence.
20' A corner kick by Espanyol is thwarted by the well prepared Junior Reis (Villarreal).
18' Yeremy Pino (Villarreal) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Munuera blows for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Espanyol.
17' The free kick is taken by Exposito (Espanyol), but ball is cleared.
16' Jose Munuera interrupts the game. One of the players from Villarreal won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Espanyol will take a free kick.
15' It’s the correct decision – NO PENALTY for Villarreal! VAR comes to the rescue of referee Jose Munuera and both teams have no complaints.

14' Play continues despite the shouts by some Villarreal players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Jose Munuera interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
13' PENALTY APPEAL by Villarreal, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!

12' Nicolas Pepe (Villarreal) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
12' Dangerous play by Roberto Fernandez Jaen (Espanyol). Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal are awarded the free kick.
11' Javi Puado (Espanyol) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
10' Espanyol are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

7' A precise low pass is received by Ayoze Perez (Villarreal), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Espanyol will have a goal kick.

5' Dani Parejo (Villarreal) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Espanyol.
4' Exposito (Espanyol) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' Logan Costa (Villarreal) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Joan Garcia, who smothers the ball.
3' The resulting set piece from Villarreal is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
2' Exposito (Espanyol) makes a rough challenge and Jose Munuera blows his whistle for a foul. Villarreal have a free kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Villarreal will have the kick-off.
The match will be delayed due to bad weather.
Jose Munuera is the one to supervise the game today.
